response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile software engineer with strong web, backend, and some systems-level experience, but the role centers on hands-on C++ development for industrial automation with SDL/IEC 62443 security practices. His only professional C++ experience is a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015; his recent decade is dominated by TypeScript/Node.js, DLang, and web platforms. He shows no evidence of MQTT, message brokers at industrial scale, IEC 62443, or industrial protocols, making him a poor match despite solid overall engineering credentials.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software engineering experience, including low-latency, high-throughput systems (DLang microservices handling millions of requests/sec)
Strong quality mindset: TDD, CI/CD, testing tools authorship, mentoring, workshops, and open-source contributions
Some systems-level exposure (C/C++ at National Instruments, embedded/audio work, multi-threading and async I/O)
concerns: Very limited and dated professional C++ experience (~7 months, ending 2015); core stack is TypeScript/Node.js/DLang
No demonstrated experience with industrial cybersecurity (IEC 62443, SDL) or industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, MQTT)
No background in automation machinery or industrial IoT domains required by the role

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering and performance-systems skills
